subject: Post-call: org diagram & sponsor identification for NovaMed pilot
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@novamed.com>, Carlos Vega <c.vega@novamed.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: org diagram & sponsor identification for NovaMed pilot

Thanks again for taking the time today — great to hear about the performance goals for the imaging-gen use case and the throughput targets you’re planning for Q3. Quick recap and a few asks so we can put together a tailored pilot plan: 

- Recap: NovaMed needs ~2k concurrent inference requests for the pre-triage pipeline, 99th pct latency target ~350ms, and a requirement that patient metadata never leaves your VPC during inference.
- Key decision criteria you mentioned: cost per inference, security controls (SOC2 / audit logs), and rollout path to prod across three regions.

Actions / asks from your side:
1) Can you share an org diagram (high level) that shows the economic buyer / budget owner, the security/compliance contacts, and the procurement contact we should loop in? A one-slide PNG or a short list is perfect.
2) Please confirm who owns the SSO/KMS decisions and whether NovaMed will require a dedicated VPC deployment for the pilot.
3) If there are any standard procurement docs (PO template, master services agreement) you can drop here or point us to, that speeds us up.

From our side we will:
- Put together a 4-week mutual action plan with milestones, success criteria, and a cost estimate for dedicated vs hosted pilot options.
- Share a short security packet (SOC2 summary, data flow diagram) and an NDA/initial SOW link for your legal team to review.

I attached a short Redwood product overview and our SOC2 one-pager for context.

Next best step: if you can share the org diagram and procurement contact by EOD Friday (4/23), we’ll have the MAP draft to you by Monday. 

Thanks — appreciate the clarity on owners today.

Alex Martinez
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | (415) 555-0183

Attachments: Redwood-Product-Overview.pdf (6 pages), Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf (2 pages)

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@novamed.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Vega <c.vega@novamed.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 17:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: org diagram & sponsor identification for NovaMed pilot

Alex — thanks for the clear recap. Really helpful.

Quick answers:
- Org chart: attaching a very small draft (see inline below) — economic buyer is Carlos Vega (VP of Engineering), security/compliance is split: Teresa Lin leads InfoSec but will bring in the cloud infra team (security@novamed.com) for network/KMS decisions. Procurement is procurement@novamed.com (I copied a procurement analyst in a separate email).
- Dedicated VPC: likely yes for the pilot; Teresa will confirm but preference is dedicated unless costs are prohibitive.

A couple asks from our side: can you send the SOC2 summary and a short network/data flow diagram that shows how Redwood would be deployed (VPC peering, private endpoints, KV/cache behavior)? Teresa will want that before we start procurement. Also, can you share an outline of the billing model if we run in dedicated mode vs hosted?

I'll try to get you the procurement POC by tomorrow.

—Sofia
Sofia Ramos
Head of AI Platforms, NovaMed Health
sofia.ramos@novamed.com

Subject: INTERNAL: prep org diagram & security pack for NovaMed (action items)

Folks — tagging you after Sofia's reply. Need to move fast on the MAP. Action items: 

- Lauren: please draft a one-slide org diagram and a short buyer/sponsor table (who they should loop in: economic buyer, procurement, InfoSec, cloud infra). Use the tentative assignments Sofia gave (Carlos, Teresa, procurement@novamed.com) but keep it editable. Target: EOD today.
- Dev: please prepare a VPC deployment sketch (data flow diagram) and a short note on how KV cache/prefix caching would work in private VPC mode. Teresa will want details on where patient metadata resides. Include references to encryption at rest/in transit and KMS options.
- Marissa: pull together billing delta (cost per 1M tokens / per-hour reserved GPU estimate) for hosted vs dedicated pilot and a short SLAs table. I’ll include these in the MAP.

Keep the deliverables tight — one slide each + a 2–3 line executive summary. I'll consolidate and send to Sofia once we have them.

Alex

Subject: MAP & next steps + request for procurement POC / org slide

Sofia / Carlos / Teresa / procurement team — thanks for the quick reply and for confirming the initial owners. Per our internal prep (attached deliverables), next steps from Redwood: 

1) I’ve shared a short mutual action plan draft for review (link below). It lays out a 4-week pilot plan, success criteria, and checkpoints with Teresa for security signoff.
2) Lauren/Dev/Marissa are attaching an org slide, VPC data-flow sketch, and cost delta (see attachments).
3) Ask from NovaMed: please confirm the procurement POC and the legal review owner for the initial SOW/NDA. If easier, we can route an initial NDA via DocuSign — link here: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/NVMD-NDA-2027

If procurement can confirm how they prefer to receive statements of work (PO + SOW vs. MSAs + Annex), we’ll tailor the paperwork. We’re happy to do a brief follow-up working session with Teresa + procurement to walk the VPC diagram and encryption notes.

Thanks — if procurement or legal want the SOC2 evidence beyond the summary, we can coordinate a limited access package under an NDA.

Best,
Alex Martinez
